Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — excited to show you a short demo of how Redwood can reduce inference cost and improve tail latency for your embeddings pipelines. Proposed slots (PDT):

- Tue Jun 8, 11:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 9, 14:00–14:30

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options. Unfortunately we’re in the middle of our quarter-end budget close and there’s a temporary spend freeze on new vendors until leadership signs off after the FY planning meeting next week. A few things:

- We’re unlikely to move forward before the FY reset (expected early July).
- We’d like to see the short demo so we can prioritize in the planning meeting; would you be open to a short 15-minute intro (no procurement discussion) just to surface value to the execs?
- Either way, could we push a full demo to the week of Jul 12?

Apologies for the shift — quarter close is always messy. Looping procurement once we have an internal OK.

Thanks,
Olivia
Director of Data Platforms
